description: The dependency dashboard is off (owner, 2026-09-10). It is a bot-written issue with no acceptance criteria that never reaches a done state, so it sits in a milestone that can then never report as finished, and it is stale between runs. Turning it off changes nothing about what Renovate watches or raises: the merge requests still arrive. ai/orbit turned it off on 2026-09-08 for the same reason; this matches it.

customManagers.description: live-check.Dockerfile's GO_VERSION ARG isn't a FROM line, so no built-in manager sees it (#1312) -- tracked here as the same golang/docker dep as the Dockerfile and .gitlab-ci.yml images so the packageRule below can group all three. GO_SHA256 on the line below is not templated: a version bump still needs its checksum updated by hand.

packageRules.description: Held below 7 while svelte-check's peer range is ^5 || ^6 -- #286 has the measurement and the trigger
go.mod's go directive, the golang image in Dockerfile and .gitlab-ci.yml, and live-check.Dockerfile's GO_VERSION ARG move together, so the four Go pins #1312 found drifted cannot drift apart again
